description: Single source of truth for image generation style. 16 geopolitical visual categories with structured prompting.
style_suffix: Retro Pixel, true 16-bit pixel art, retro SNES style, chunky pixels, low resolution, 8-bit color, isometric perspective, hard pixel edges, limited color palette, flat colors, dramatic lighting
clip_style_tag: 16-bit isometric pixel art, isometric perspective, vibrant colors
negative_prompt: text, words, letters, watermark, signature, logo, UI elements, HUD, speech bubbles, captions, subtitles, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, noise, distorted proportions, photorealistic, 3D render, 3D rendered, CGI, anime, cartoon mascot, cartoon character, character portrait, single figure, sketch, pencil drawing, watercolor, smooth gradients, soft shading, anti-aliasing, color bleed, blended colors, smooth shading, realistic lighting, single isolated object, object on plain background, floating object, extreme close-up, macro shot, product photo, still life, screen-within-screen, picture-in-picture, minimalist, abstract shapes, plain background, white background, centered subject without environment, scene without depth, oversize pixels on realistic base, dithering, nsfw, gore, peaceful landscape, nature scenery
color_palette_prompt: color palette: dark navy blue (#0A1628), amber orange (#FFA500), cyan blue (#00D4FF), slate gray (#4A5568)

generation_params.pixel_art_enforcement_prefix: Clean 32-bit pixel art, high contrast news graphic, isometric style, uniform grid-aligned pixels, no anti-aliasing, no color bleeding, no soft gradients

warfare.additional_prompts: detailed military equipment, explosions, smoke, tactical formations, battlefield terrain

naval.additional_prompts: warships, ocean waves, naval formations, maritime flags, fleet maneuvers

aerial.additional_prompts: military aircraft, contrails, sky formations, payload detail, altitude perspective

arms_defense.additional_prompts: military hardware closeup, technical schematics, weapon systems, national insignia

markets.additional_prompts: trading screens, stock tickers, price charts, financial data visualization, trading floor

trade_sanctions.additional_prompts: cargo containers, shipping port, trade barriers, customs checkpoint, commercial vessels

energy.additional_prompts: oil refinery, pipeline infrastructure, power plant, flames, industrial complex

commodities.additional_prompts: resource extraction, supply queues, scarcity indicators, warehouse shelves, raw materials

diplomacy.additional_prompts: summit meeting room, diplomatic table, national flags, official documents, formal atmosphere

political.additional_prompts: government building, parliament chamber, podium, political rally, ballot boxes

espionage.additional_prompts: surveillance monitors, classified documents, encrypted data, shadows, covert operations

protests.additional_prompts: demonstration crowd, protest banners, police barricades, city streets, civil unrest

humanitarian.additional_prompts: refugee convoy, aid tents, emergency supplies, displacement camp, humanitarian crisis

border.additional_prompts: border fence, checkpoint, guard towers, vehicle queue, no-mans land terrain

cyber.additional_prompts: server room, holographic data, network attack visualization, digital infrastructure, warning alerts

megaprojects.additional_prompts: massive construction site, cranes, engineering scale, route maps, heavy machinery

hook.camera: dramatic close-up or wide aerial view
hook.lighting: high contrast, dramatic dusk lighting with orange and red sky
hook.spatial: subject centered in foreground, environment pushed back

historical_1.framing: era-accurate equipment and settings, archival feel
historical_1.lighting: sepia-amber tint, grainy vintage film look, muted warm tones
historical_1.spatial: wide establishing shot, formations visible in mid-ground

historical_2.framing: different era than historical_1, multi-layered context
historical_2.lighting: cold war era palette, olive drab and high contrast
historical_2.spatial: strategic overview, tactical positions mapped across frame

modern_pivot.framing: modern equipment, 2020s technology, sharp clean lines
modern_pivot.lighting: modern HD lighting, bright contemporary feel, sharp shadows
modern_pivot.spatial: dynamic composition with depth, foreground action leading to background context

consequence.framing: civilian scale, everyday life impacted, emotional framing
consequence.lighting: harsh midday light or cold blue economic lighting
consequence.spatial: subject at human scale in foreground, wider impact visible in background

future_outlook.camera: wide strategic map view or revealing pullback shot
future_outlook.lighting: golden hour or twilight, contemplative atmosphere
future_outlook.spatial: wide frame revealing full strategic picture, lingering perspective

escalation.framing: intensity building, multiple elements in motion
escalation.lighting: harsh dramatic lighting, high contrast, stormy
escalation.spatial: converging elements, tension in spatial arrangement

twist.camera: revealing wide shot or unexpected angle
twist.spatial: new perspective revealing what was hidden
